story.iWant: 验证所有基础功能能够正常工作
story.soThat: 确保项目核心功能的稳定性
story.tasks:
Task 1: 端到端测试框架搭建 (AC: 1) - Subtask 1.1: 设置E2E测试环境和工具链 - Subtask 1.2: 创建测试数据和模拟环境 - Subtask 1.3: 实现完整用户流程测试
Task 2: 边界条件和错误处理测试 (AC: 2) - Subtask 2.1: 数据获取异常情况测试 - Subtask 2.2: 策略计算边界条件测试 - Subtask 2.3: API错误响应测试
Task 3: 性能基准测试 (AC: 3) - Subtask 3.1: 数据获取性能测试 - Subtask 3.2: 策略计算性能测试 - Subtask 3.3: 并发负载测试
Task 4: 部署脚本和文档 (AC: 4) - Subtask 4.1: 创建Docker部署脚本 - Subtask 4.2: 编写部署文档 - Subtask 4.3: 创建环境配置指南
Task 5: 代码质量保证 (AC: 5) - Subtask 5.1: 设置代码质量检查工具 - Subtask 5.2: 建立代码覆盖率报告 - Subtask 5.3: 创建代码审查检查清单

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. 编写端到端测试，验证完整的数据获取到策略回测流程 2. 测试各种边界条件和错误情况 3. 验证性能指标（数据获取和策略计算速度） 4. 创建基础的部署脚本和文档 5. 确保代码质量和可维护性

doc.title: Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Testing strategy with three layers: unit tests (>80% coverage), integration tests, and end-to-end tests for complete user journey validation and performance target verification.

doc.title: Epic 1 Technical Context
doc.snippet: Complete testing framework setup with pytest for backend, Jest + React Testing Library + Playwright for frontend, and specific performance requirements: API response < 500ms, strategy calculation < 10s, page loading < 3s.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: System performance requirements: page loading time < 3 seconds, strategy backtesting response time < 10 seconds, maintainable code structure with clear modularity and detailed comments.

doc.title: Architecture Documentation
doc.snippet: Vercel deployment configuration with automatic CI/CD, environment separation (dev/test/production), Docker containerization, and performance optimization strategies including caching and async task queues.

doc.title: Market Data API Specification
doc.snippet: Performance specifications: cache hit response < 50ms, API call response 1-5s, with complete error handling, logging, and comprehensive unit/integration testing requirements.

tests.standards: Three-tier testing approach: Unit tests (>80% coverage) using pytest for backend and Jest for frontend, Integration tests for API interactions and database operations, End-to-end tests using Playwright for complete user journey validation. Performance tests to verify API response < 500ms, strategy calculation < 10s, page loading < 3s.

Test various error scenarios: network failures, invalid parameters, rate limits, cache misses
